title: Which Pot Resort Credit Is Drawn From on a Resort Lodging Settlement
content:
Which pot resort credit is drawn from on a Resort Lodging settlement follows what the household holds. Credit counts only where the record carrying it is itself live: a season pass record standing active for the season of the stay under the Season Pass Programme, or a ticket order standing in use for that season under Lift Tickets.

Where the household holds resort credit standing on a season pass record standing active for the season of the stay and credit standing on a ticket order standing in use for that season as well, the credit on the pass record is drawn first and only what it does not cover is drawn from the ticket order, up to what is left to be collected.

Where the household holds resort credit standing on a season pass record standing active for that season and none standing on a ticket order standing in use, the credit on the pass record is drawn, up to what is left to be collected.

Where the household holds resort credit standing on a ticket order standing in use for that season and none standing on a season pass record standing active, the credit on the ticket order is drawn, up to what is left to be collected.

Where the household holds neither, no credit is drawn.

| Credit on a live season pass record | Credit on a live ticket order | What is drawn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the pass record credit first, then from the ticket order only what it does not cover, up to what is left to be collected |
| yes | no | the pass record credit, up to what is left to be collected |
| no | yes | the ticket order credit, up to what is left to be collected |
| no | no | nothing |

### Three hypothetical households, where 500.00 USD is left to be collected

A household holding 300.00 USD of credit on a season pass record standing active for the season of the stay and 400.00 USD on a ticket order standing in use for that season draws the 300.00 USD from the pass record first, and of the ticket order credit only the 200.00 USD the pass credit did not cover, which comes to the 500.00 USD left to be collected.

A household holding 300.00 USD on the pass record and none on any live ticket order draws 300.00 USD.

A household whose ticket order carrying credit is no longer in use, and which holds no season pass record standing active for that season, holds credit on no live record, and no credit is drawn.
